Name: Zeeb, Prince of Midian
Summary: Zeeb, a prince of Midian, was captured and killed by Ephraim at the winepress of Zeeb during Gideon's victory.
KeyStory: Ephraim pursued the fleeing Midianites and slew Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb, bringing the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Oreb, Prince of Midian; Zebah, King of Midian; Zalmunna, King of Midian
LifeLesson: Two princes, two landmarks: the victory was remembered in the landscape.
